title: Visual Memory
description: Production-local registry of recurring visual entities and their canonical references. Gives a pipeline object-identity continuity (the same subject across many shots), distinct from style consistency. Populated by the scene planner (declares entities) and the asset director (binds canonical asset paths).

kind.description: generated = AI image reused via reference conditioning; rendered = deterministic SVG/Remotion re-render (diagrams/text — avoids AI text hallucination); style_anchor = environment/mood carried by prompt, not a single object.

reuse_topology.description: canonical_anchor = every derived view conditions on the ONE canonical asset (prevents drift). progressive = each view chains from the previous (deliberate transformation over time).

generator_locked.description: Provider/model pinned for ALL views of this entity, to avoid cross-provider style leak (e.g. flux_kontext).

canonical_scene_id.description: The scene that introduces and defines the entity.

canonical_asset_path.description: Bound by the asset director after the canonical asset is generated.

identity_anchors.description: The invariant traits that MUST persist across every view (e.g. grey-white facial disc, twin black crown feathers).

allowed_variations.description: What is permitted to change between views (shot size, camera angle, pose).

continuity_threshold.description: Minimum CLIP cosine similarity vs canonical for a derived view to pass the continuity gate.

scene_links.description: Maps scenes to entities. Mirrors scene_plan.reuse; lets the asset director order generation canonical-first.
